QuestInfo.name: The Lost Permit 1
QuestInfo.0:
You met 10 Boogies, and she seems to have lost something...
This isn't the best start, but she might have something useful for you to do.
QuestInfo.1:
10 Boogies lost the Ereve Investigation Permit!
Follow her to where she thinks she lost it. It was near Timu.

You can search for 'Timu' in the World Map UI (Hotkey W) to find the location.
You can find the location more easily if you add it to your Navigation.
QuestInfo.2: You went to #m130010110# as 10 Boogies asked, but the Ereve Investigation Permit is nowhere to be found.

1.0: Did you just now get here?\r\n#L0##bYeah, how did you... Did you find what you were looking for?#l\n#k
